description: List the logged-in user's notifications (order created / filled / cancelled / reclaimed, referral payouts) newest first, with the unread count. Use to follow up on an order after creating it; page with `offset`/`limit`, and mark items read with `tronsave_mark_notifications_read`. Requires a wallet signature identity. Read-only.

offset.description: Number of notifications to skip for pagination (default 0); add `limit` to page forward.

unreadOnly.description: true returns only unread notifications; default false returns all.

name: tronsave_list_notifications
title: Notifications
